tagline: Soft walls on every side, and deep sherpa in the middle to burrow into.
lead: Your dog can turn, knead and burrow until they drop, with cushioned walls to press into and sherpa moulding round them.
value: Upholstery-weight stonewashed fabric and a proper sherpa cushion, and every cover zips off and washes at 30°C.
intro: Linnet is a high-walled bolster nest bed in green stonewashed fabric, with a deep sherpa-fleece cushion, springy virgin fibre filling, a non-slip base and zipped covers that wash at 30°C. Five sizes, XS to XL.
points: Somewhere for a chin or a back, whichever way they turn.
Soft and warm where they actually lie.
Springy virgin fibre filling by design. This is a nest, not a firm foam mattress.
Zipped, removable and machine washable at 30°C.
Five sizes, so a small dog isn't lost in a bed built for a Labrador.
best_for: Dogs who turn, knead and burrow before settling, from toy breeds to retrievers. Not for dogs who need firm support.
fit_note: Sleeping areas: XS 33 × 23cm, Small 42 × 28cm, Medium 48 × 34cm, Large 50 × 42cm, XL 72 × 55cm. Go by these, not the outside size. Measure your dog curled up, and size up if between sizes.
care: Remove the zipped covers and machine wash at 30°C. Air-dry before refitting. Do not tumble dry.

seo_description: A high-walled nest dog bed for dogs who burrow, with a deep sherpa cushion and covers that wash at 30°C. Green stonewashed fabric, five sizes XS to XL.
